antiPattern: Flat colored box labeled 'Source Code' connected to another flat box labeled 'Binary'.
visualMetaphor: Realistic IDE Code Editor window (traffic lights, file tab, line numbers, syntax-highlighted code) feeding into a rotating mechanical gear ('javac' / 'rustc') that stamps out a glowing binary capsule.
studioPrimitive: Illustrations.codeEditorWindow(...) + Illustrations.compilerGear(...) + Illustrations.bytecodeCapsule(...)

antiPattern: Three identical rounded pills labeled Windows, Linux, macOS.
visualMetaphor: Three distinct hardware silhouettes: a Desktop Workstation Monitor (Windows), a 19-inch Datacenter Rack Server with blinking LEDs (Linux), and an unfolded sleek Laptop (macOS) — each running an embedded runtime engine.
studioPrimitive: Layout.fanOutTargets(3, ...) + Illustrations.hardwareMachine(ctx, x, cy, { type: 'pc' | 'server' | 'laptop', osIcon })
